rules: Do not create a new system when an existing Creative Excellence or Literary Prose authority already owns the capability.
Referenced-but-unrecovered pre-012 packet contents may not be invented.

A capability is not considered closed merely because it appears in a prose prompt or high-level specialist list; it needs an explicit data contract, evidence representation, decision rule and qualification owner where material.
No scalar literary quality score may compensate for hard preservation or applicability failures.
Author authority, canon, protected language and project-specific voice remain non-transferable hard authorities.

gaps.name: Narrative time model
gaps.problem: Current pacing ownership does not yet prove a first-class executable representation of story-time versus discourse-time, temporal order, duration and frequency across the book.
required_capabilities: temporal consistency and intentional transgression evidence
gaps.likely_owner: BOOK_STATE_GRAPH + Literary Prose STEP-E/F + pacing authority
gaps.research_basis: Narratology treats order, duration and frequency as distinct temporal axes; recent long-form consistency work continues to operationalize these separately.

gaps.name: Information latency / reveal frontier
gaps.problem: Information release exists diagnostically, but no unified book-scale ledger proves when a fact/question is introduced, withheld, partially answered, revealed, recalled or made stale.

gaps.name: Inquiry / suspense state
gaps.problem: Tension and reader questions are present conceptually, but suspense needs explicit evolving questions, candidate answers, stakes and termination conditions rather than generic tension labels.

gaps.name: Entity-event-causal state graph
gaps.problem: Passage and character states exist, but book-scale causality and event evolution need explicit persistent graph authority rather than repeated context reconstruction.

gaps.name: Arc intelligence
gaps.problem: Whole-book integration names character/theme/setup-payoff domains, but the new runtime does not yet prove durable arc objects that update across passages and support regression testing.

gaps.name: Book-length evaluation fusion
gaps.problem: Creative Excellence 017 designed multi-resolution evidence, but Literary Prose real-book qualification still needs an executable fusion of local detail, incremental state and global-summary perspectives without a compensating scalar score.
required_capabilities: ending/arc/payoff cannot be hidden by strong excerpts

gaps.name: Synthetic-reader to human-reader calibration runtime
gaps.problem: Creative Excellence 013/014 designs 64 reader dimensions and holdout calibration, but Literary Prose does not yet consume real human observation to estimate where synthetic reader predictions are reliable or misleading.

gaps.name: Granular prose dimension runtime binding
gaps.problem: The 56 recovered Packet-012 dimensions exist as design authority but are not yet individually mapped to executable STEP-E/F/H/I/K evidence owners.

gaps.name: Pre-012 specialist lineage recovery/equivalence
gaps.problem: Pacing, originality, character/dialogue and depth/subtext/theme are referenced as prior authorities, but their standalone historical packet artifacts were not recovered. Current capabilities must be cross-qualified for equivalence without inventing history.
required_capabilities: granular taxonomy reconstruction from research only as a NEW revision

gaps.name: Revision experiment protocol integration
gaps.problem: Literary Prose generates and evaluates bounded candidates, but Packet-015 controls for multiple variants, post-hoc discoveries, stopping, negative results and reader contamination are not yet fully inherited into every material revision campaign.

research_additions_to_existing_taxonomy: narrative interest should distinguish suspense, curiosity and surprise rather than collapse them into engagement
pacing should represent nonlinearity, information latency and closure separately from sentence-level speed
focalization and speech-presentation modes should remain distinct from generic POV correctness
reader comprehension/affect must be treated as reception evidence rather than direct text-quality truth
book-length evaluation should combine detail-sensitive aggregation with global views and mandatory critical-moment coverage
